name: Brand Strategy
purpose: Convert discovery and evidence into a defensible strategy: category, audience, positioning, promise, value proposition, differentiation, proof and guardrails.
triggers: a BRAND_DISCOVERY_BRIEF.md exists and is adequate
positioning is needed before identity (verbal or visual) work
non_triggers: writing the brand book / verbal system
choosing fonts, colors, or visual system
generating social posts or production content
building the discovery brief itself from raw research
quality_gates: positioning is not generic (passes commoditization swap test)
differentiation connects to evidence, not invention
discarded alternatives documented with specific reasons
guardrails are operational, not mood words
no visual- or verbal-execution leakage into strategy artifacts
stop_conditions: all three artifacts produced, commoditization test passed, discarded territories documented -> COMPLETE
discovery brief lacks audience evidence/competitive frame/distinguishing fact -> BLOCKED, state what's missing, recommend re-running brand-discovery
never ship a position that fails the commoditization swap test or invents unsupported differentiation
